name: interview
description: Interview the user to understand a problem thoroughly before building anything, so the whole picture can be drawn rather than guessed. Two depths: deep (65-100 questions, exhaustive) and quick (~15, one pass) over the same 9 layers, from root purpose to the process contract. Bilingual (English / Tiếng Việt). Asks one question at a time, collects concrete examples, illustrations and references as it goes, sketches the whole picture mid-interview for correction, then synthesizes one self-contained HTML file with a whole-picture diagram, a process contract of steps whose inputs and outputs are checked for chaining, and acceptance criteria, backed by the evidence and an explicit list of what is still open or deferred.
